acceptance_tests.name: Dense Unitary Equivalence Test
acceptance_tests.description: Calculates the Frobenius norm of difference between full circuit unitaries.

acceptance_tests.name: Statevector Equivalence Test
acceptance_tests.description: Applies raw and optimized unitaries to random initial states and asserts result vector identity.

acceptance_tests.name: Random Circuit Differential Testing
acceptance_tests.description: Generates random sequences of gates, runs optimization, and asserts unitary equivalence.

acceptance_tests.name: Boundary Parameter Testing
acceptance_tests.description: Asserts correct trigonometric merging and identity resolution for rotation boundary parameters.

acceptance_tests.name: Invalid Rewrite Rejection
acceptance_tests.description: Ensures the optimizer rejects rewrites when control/target qubits or parameter values do not match.

acceptance_tests.name: Multi-Rule Interaction Testing
acceptance_tests.description: Verifies that ordering of sequential passes (e.g. Hadamard cancellation then CNOT cancellation) preserves correctness.
